'''Proximity detonators''' were a specialized form of [[Detonator/Legends|detonator]]. They were used to trigger explosives like [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] using a target's bio-signature.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
